final_assessment: BOUNDED settled in one sitting, as intended. The obligation is ACCOUNTED, not CLOSED — closure was never the point; no domain may be open silently. Two outcomes discharge it: CLOSED (DERIVED/SOURCED) and OPEN-DECLARED (BOUNDED, with the residual naming its KIND and METHOD). The tier difference is VISIBILITY, never blocking, which is rc02's budgetExhausted shape. Case 1 ran the test against every bounded claim on the record and it rejected one of the previous attempt's own two residuals — the closure taxonomy named a kind and no method and survived three internal passes. Crucially this is a RECORD rather than a check, the first application of R-crc-10, which was ratified the same day out of the failure this exploration repairs. D-bcs-5 closes the recursion deliberately: the question of whether the kind-and-method test is itself closed is NOT pursued, because the move set went five to six to eight to nine by exactly that route and pursuing it is how this becomes the third stage to ship nothing.
